import os,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def analyze(I,O):
    H=len(I);W=len(I[0]); flat=[x for r in I for x in r]

    # band/gap structure
    band_rows=[r for r in range(H) if any(x!=0 for x in I[r])]
    bands=[];cur=[]

    gaps=[list(range(bands[i][0]+bands[i][-1]+2)) for i in range(len(bands)-1)]
    print('bands',[(b[0],b[-1]) for b in bands],'gaps',gaps)
    # rows changed
    changes=[r for r in range(H) if I[r]!=O[r]]
    print('changed rows',changes)
    for r in changes:
        diff=[j for j in range(W) if I[r][j]!=O[r][j]]
        vals=set(O[r][j] for j in diff)

    H=len(g);W=len(g[0]); bl=[];cur=[]
    for r in range(H):
        if any(x!=0 for x in g[r]): cur.append(r)
        elif cur: bl.append(cur);cur=[]
    if cur: bl.append(cur)
    return bl
def f(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; H=len(g);W=len(g[0])
    bl=bands_of(g)
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    n=len(bl)
    for bi in range(n):
        band=bl[bi]
        # segment runs in first row of band
        row=band[0]; runs=[];k=0
        while k<W:
            j=k
            while j<W and g[row][j]!=0: j+=1
            if j>k: runs.append((k,j)); k=j+1
            else: k+=1
        for a,b in runs:
            c=g[row][a+1]
            cnt=collections.Counter(g[r][a+1] for r in band)
            m=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
            if c==m: continue
            # horizontal: fill zeros in anomaly row between outermost boundaries of run extents
            L=a;R=b
            while L>0 and g[row][L-1]==0: L-=1
            while R<W-1 and g[row][R+1]==0: R+=1
            for cc in range(L,R+1):
                if out[row][cc]==0: out[row][cc]=c
            # vertical: anomaly column downward through zero rows until next band
            col=a+1
            top=band[-1]
            if bi+1<n: bot=bl[bi+1][0]
            else: bot=H
            for r2 in range(top+1,bot):
                for cc2 in range(col, col+1):
                    if out[r2][cc2]==0: out[r2][cc2]=c
    return out
